2150.fix: Don't fire the same request simultaneously. This results in one request giving the error as 'Duplicate IRN request'. Best way to avoid firing of IRN request repeatedly for the same request, is update in your system with IRN number when the response comes back. Next time check the IRN, if it is not there, then fire for IRN.

2172.message: For Intra-state transaction, IGST amount is not applicable; only CGST and SGST amounts are applicable
2172.fix: Please check the applicable taxes for current transaction. If the State code of Point of Supply (POS) of recipient is same is state code of Supplier, then CSGT and SGST applies. However, under exception circumstances as per rule if IGST is applicable for intrastate transaction, then pass the ‘IGST_on_IntraState_Supply’ flag as ‘Y’ with IGST value so that system can process your request.
